title: Long-Horizon Research Delivery Rubric
scoring_note: Use after deterministic checks. Judge the delivered report and the full correction trail, not the amount of backstage activity.

dimensions.name: primary_object_fidelity
dimensions.excellent: The report directly explains pipeline ownership, handoffs, decisions, and feedback loops.
dimensions.poor: The pipeline question is displaced by general AI trends, methodology, source channels, or advice lists.

dimensions.name: late_requirement_followthrough
dimensions.excellent: Every material follow-up correction is reflected in the final structure and wording or disclosed as an accepted limitation.
dimensions.poor: Late corrections disappear after earlier drafts or completion is claimed before the final requirement turn.

dimensions.name: company_specific_mechanism
dimensions.excellent: Each company has an evidence-bounded operating model with distinct teams, interfaces, decision rights, model-node evolution, and careful use of hiring responsibilities as interface evidence.
dimensions.poor: Industry commonplaces are copied into eight company rows without company-level evidence, or job duties are treated as proof of undisclosed reporting lines.

dimensions.name: evidence_and_uncertainty
dimensions.excellent: Claims are traceable and unknown reporting lines or internal processes remain explicitly unknown.
dimensions.poor: Missing company evidence is silently filled with another company's practice or confident inference.

dimensions.name: delivery_integrity
dimensions.excellent: User-visible status, current state, global review, artifact hashes, and disclosed limitations agree.
dimensions.poor: A local pass, old receipt, or partial milestone is promoted to final completion.

dimensions.name: process_proportionality
dimensions.excellent: State is small, current, and sufficient for recovery and verification.
dimensions.poor: Control files, transaction machinery, or oversized progress logs displace research work.

dimensions.name: reader_quality
dimensions.excellent: Insights are specific, comparisons are legible, the prose reads as a finished research report, figurative language clarifies rather than replaces concrete mechanisms or evidence boundaries, and explicitly rejected appendices stay absent.
dimensions.poor: The report exposes process narration, generic slogans, repetitive contrasts, stacked decorative metaphors, unexplained tables, or a glossary/reference appendix the reader rejected.

pass_guidance: A pass requires no unresolved delivery-integrity failure and a strong score on primary-object fidelity.
